use System.StringSplitOptions.REMOVE_EMPTY_ENTRIES

let puzzle = [
    "__ 33 35 __ __  .  .  .",
    "__ __ 24 22 __  .  .  .",
    "__ __ __ 21 __ __  .  .",
    "__ 26 __ 13 40 11  .  .",
    "27 __ __ __  9 __  1  .",
    " .  . __ __ 18 __ __  .",
    " .  .  .  . __  7 __ __",
    " .  .  .  .  .  .  5 __"
]

let hole = -1
let blank = 0

let rows = puzzle.count
cells(line: string) -> string[] => line.split([' '], REMOVE_EMPTY_ENTRIES)

let columns = cells(puzzle[0]).count

let board =
    puzzle
        |> flat_map(line => cells(line))
        |> map(cell =>
            if cell =~ "." then hole
            elif cell =~ "__" then blank
            else int.parse(cell)
            fi)
        |> collect_list()

let given = SET[int](board |> filter(n => n > 0))
let last = given |> reduce(0, (a, b) => System.Math.max(a, b))

at(row: int, column: int) -> int =>
    if row < 0 \/ row >= rows \/ column < 0 \/ column >= columns then hole
    else board[row * columns + column]

    let square = at(row, column)

    let wrong =
        square == hole \/
        (square != blank /\ square != n) \/
        (square == blank /\ given.contains(n))

    if wrong then
        return false
    fi

    if n == last then
        board[row * columns + column] = n
        return true
    fi

    board[row * columns + column] = n

    for dr in -1::1 do
        for dc in -1::1 do
            let moves = dr != 0 \/ dc != 0

            if moves /\ place(row + dr, column + dc, n + 1) then
                return true
            fi
        od
    od

    board[row * columns + column] = square
    false

            (0..columns)
                |> map(column =>

                    fi)
                |> join(" ")

        write_line(line.trim_end())
    od
